name: hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c7_cts-mc3c7_cts-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-MC3D 10-20: route hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c6_t242-mc3c6_t242-712f808fd NEEDS_RTL TT -160.9 / FF -29.67 ps (1041 TT D pins). Classified from 6_finish.rpt: worst path metadata_wp[0][0] -> META_SELECT[16].FORWARD[1].mf_valid has 734 ps clk->D (only 3 logic gates; a 164 ps INVx4 + 4 wire buffers = one we net spread over 20 regions) AND 186 ps launch-late skew; report_clock_skew 694 vs 402 ps source/target latency. CTS log: spine leaf spread 28.7 ps planned, so the post-route skew is the pre-placed clock SPINE (OT_SPINE_PORT, macro leaves) degrading after detail route -- the same class that failed h9b and closed as h9c with local TritonCTS. Fix: clock = cts (TritonCTS, leaf tile with no hard children, 241.92 x 272.16) Parallel fallback of hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c7_wel. UPDATE: the gate's pre-gate native census (current tools) also fails the unchanged MC3c v6 netlist (accepted 34 loads via 22 K-region count_q muxes; AQ wr_ok_h 43 loads into the head capture muxes), so this fallback runs WE_LOCAL=2: regional-pop count_q/metadata_wp/unposted_aq selects + second wr_ok_h cone (WROK_COPIES=2), original META forward path.
